props.label: Hyundai iX35 SUV Hire in Melbourne

data.name: Hyundai iX35 Long-Term Hire
data.description: Long-term SUV hire across Melbourne. A comfortable, capable Hyundai iX35 for everyday driving, family trips and extended stays.

mainEntity.name: How much does the iX35 cost to hire long-term?

acceptedAnswer.text: The iX35 is $180 inc. GST per week including GST, with 1,400 km included each week and a $500 bond.

mainEntity.name: How many seats and how much boot space?

acceptedAnswer.text: The iX35 seats 5 with a generous SUV boot for luggage, gear and the weekly shop.
Yes, the iX35 is automatic, smooth, easy and comfortable for everyday driving.

mainEntity.name: Can I hire it for an extended stay in Melbourne?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The iX35 is ideal for extended stays, with flexible weekly and monthly terms and no long lock-in contract.
